text:
Lena: Heads-up - customer 'GreenGrid' got blocked by processor this morning. Decline code: card_not_supported + processor_note: 'BIN_VELOCITY_LIMIT'. Multiple cards tried and ACH verify timed out. Can someone triage?
Omar: Which charges/invoice?
Lena: inv-GG-2109, charges ch_03KLMN... x2. Last4 3714 and 6011. Both returns same processor_note.
Zoe: 'BIN_VELOCITY_LIMIT' usually means the BIN exceeded some behavior threshold with that processor. Could be temporary. We should stop autopay retries to avoid amplifying the block.
Kasia: Agreed on pausing retries. Finance ok to offer alternative payment methods (wire or virtual card) if customer requests. We'll waive one late fee if they switch to wire within 48h.
Omar: I'll flip the merchant routing to try alternate processor p-omega for this merchant only, rollout 5% to start. If p-omega accepts, we'll expand.
PaymentsBot: Rolling out alternate processor p-omega for merchant greengrid (5%) - initial results: 0 successes, 1 failure. Monitoring https://monitoring.redwood/payments/greengrid
Lena: Customer reports urgent payroll is scheduled tomorrow, so wire is safest. Kasia, can we provide bank details and the exact remittance format we need?
Kasia: Internal wire template: Bank: Wells Fargo; Account Name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Account #: 555333222; ABA: 121000248; SWIFT: WFBIUS6S; Reference: GreenGrid-INVOICE-GG-2109. Remittance must include invoice number and paying contact name.
Zoe: Also created Zendesk ticket Z#11345 and put the account on autopay-suspend flag.
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#11345 created - GreenGrid payment failure.
Omar: Quick patch applied to billing-config to set retries -> [] for this merchant until we clear. Pushed.
Lena: Commands I used to surface logs: `curl -s "https://payments.redwood/internal/failed_charges?merchant=greengrid" | jq .`
Kasia: Finance ops note: once wire clears, tag invoice as 'settled-wire' and cancel any scheduled retries. Please attach bank trace and remittance.
Zoe: Opening support case with processor p-alpha: PROC-8721. Will ask for reasoning and timeline for BIN unblocking.
PaymentsBot: Alert configured: escalate to oncall if >3 failed attempts in 6h for same merchant.
Lena: I sent wire instructions to customer and asked for payment ETA + remittance screenshot. Also offered virtual card option via our payment partner if they prefer faster settlement.
Omar: If they take the virtual card, we need accounting to accept virtual-card settlements and mark invoice 'settled-virtual'. Kasia ok?
Kasia: Yes, we can accept virtual card. Same remittance requirement applies. Waiver still stands if completed within 48h.
Zoe: Update from processor: they flagged BIN due to unusual transaction velocity tied to that BIN across multiple merchants. They recommended cooldown 24h or token refresh. Case PROC-8721 opened.
Lena: Thanks. Quick follow-ups: add BIN velocity to our test harness and add an automated mute policy so we don't retry more than twice when processor returns BIN_VELOCITY_LIMIT.
Omar: Agreed - I'll add a rule to payments-gating to stop retries on that error class. Deployed.
Zoe: Logged final steps in the Zendesk ticket and noted the waiver.
Kasia: Finance ops standing by for remittance.
Lena: Closing loop - Omar did routing, Zoe opened processor case, Kasia approved waiver, I sent wire template to customer. Will update when wire clears. :thumbsup:
